# AiGovOps Foundation

> AiGovOps Foundation is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that builds open-source AI governance operations — policy as code, signed evidence receipts (Beacon), and tools that conform to OVERT, the open standard for runtime trust, which the Foundation co-stewards with CHAI (Coalition for Health AI). Everything is Apache-2.0.

The front door offers six actions: become a member, give, join a meeting, read the newsletter, get an audit plan, or book the founders. The Library is free for members; meetings are Thursdays at 15:00 Pacific.

## Start here
- [AiGovOps Foundation — Ship Safe AI. Never Unsafe AI.](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/): Ship safe AI — never unsafe AI. Sit down at the AiGovOps Foundation café: say what brought you in, run the ten-minute Gate Check, and leave in an hour with a rule, a signed receipt and a Thursday.
- [What Is AiGovOps? And Why We Built the AiGovOps Foundation to Advance It | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/what-is-aigovops.html): Every AI system deployed without automated governance creates technical debt that compounds. Every compliance framework that exists only as a PDF is a...
- [AI Governance Frameworks Explorer | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/frameworks.html): Find which AI governance frameworks apply to your organization — EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, GDPR, HIPAA, and 35+ more. Filter by region, industry, and risk level.
- [Open source | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/open-source.html): The open source — one practice (four levels, one hour each) and three engines: Beacon signs, Umbrella declares, Lantern reads. Apache-2.0, conforming to OVERT. Ship safe AI — never unsafe AI.
- [The Library | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/library.html): The Library — one hundred verified AI harms, each with the gate that would have caught it; the practitioner test; the gates, live; forty frameworks. Free to read: join with an email, nothing more. Ship safe AI — never unsafe AI.
- [Support | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/support.html): Fund the open-source AI governance standard. Every contribution keeps policy-as-code free, verifiable, and global.
- [Founders | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/founders.html): Ken Johnston and Bob Rapp — co-founders of the AiGovOps Foundation. AI and data leadership from Microsoft, Ford, Autonomic.ai, Vodafone, IBM Watson, GE Healthcare, and General Motors.
- [Thursday | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/community.html): Thursday at 15:00 Pacific is where receipts are shown and marks are made. Join free, come on Thursday, give an hour. Ship safe AI — never unsafe AI.
- [AI governance for startup founders | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/for-founders.html): A practical starting path for startup founders exploring AI risk, the AiGovOps practice, and a 10-minute Gate Check.
- [AI governance for enterprise governance leads | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/for-enterprise.html): Map AI governance standards, explore the Vendor RFI, and book a conversation with the AiGovOps Foundation founders.
- [AI governance for students | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/for-students.html): Start learning AI governance with the Foundation’s guide, Practice Level 100, and the Thursday community meeting.
- [AI governance for researchers | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/for-researchers.html): Explore OVERT, Beacon source, and the Library’s 100 verified AI-harm cases, with clear routes to the underlying materials.
- [AI governance for regulators and policy staff | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/for-regulators.html): Explore OVERT runtime evidence, verify a Beacon receipt in the browser demo, and talk with the Foundation’s founders.
- [AI governance for open-source contributors | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/for-contributors.html): Find contribution guides for Beacon, Umbrella, and Vendor RFI, then join the Foundation’s Thursday community meeting.

## Topics
- [What Is AI Governance? | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/ai-governance.html): See how AI governance becomes operational through policy as code, evidence that ships, and receipts an auditor can verify.
- [What Is AiGovOps? | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/aigovops.html): AiGovOps treats AI governance like code: versioned, tested, and verifiable before deployment.
- [Is AiGovOps Foundation a Nonprofit? | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/nonprofit.html): Learn what the AiGovOps Foundation builds, how support is used, and how its public finances are reported.
- [What Is OVERT? | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/overt.html): OVERT is an open runtime-trust standard for independently verifiable evidence; the Foundation is co-steward with CHAI.
- [Glossary | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/glossary.html): Plain-language definitions for AiGovOps Foundation tools, evidence, and practice.
- [What Is Beacon? | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/beacon.html): Beacon is an OVERT 1.0-conformant runtime that produces signed, verifiable receipts of AI decisions.
- [How Do I Create an AI Audit Plan? | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/audit.html): Use the 10-minute Gate Check, Vendor RFI, and mapped Library cases to begin an AI audit plan.
- [Which AI Governance Starter Kits Can I Use? | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/starter-kits.html): Explore Practice levels 100–400, English and Spanish worksheets, NCW AI Camp, Vendor RFI, Beacon, and Gate Check.

- [ISO 42001 as controls you can run, not a binder you file | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/iso-42001-controls-you-can-run.html): ISO 42001 is the AI management system standard. Treat its controls as checks you run in CI, each leaving a receipt an auditor can read, not a document you file.
- [The premise — Robodebt and the gate before the first notice | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/the-premise.html): Australia's automated debt scheme averaged annual income into fortnights, fabricated debts for anyone with irregular earnings, and reversed the burden of proof onto about 440,000 people. The gate is not on the notice. It is on the arithmetic, before a single notice goes out. Level 400.
- [Seconds each — the hold that Cigna's PXDX never had | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/seconds-each.html): ProPublica reported that Cigna's PXDX process let medical directors deny large batches of claims in seconds each, often without opening the patient's file. The gate is a human who actually reviews before a denial — and the arithmetic of what "actually" means when the batch is a thousand deep. Level 300.
- [Forty-five minutes at Knight Capital — the deploy is the decision | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/forty-five-minutes-at-knight.html): In 2012 a faulty deploy sent $7 billion of unintended orders in 45 minutes and cost Knight Capital $440 million and the firm. No LLM anywhere. The gate it needed is the one your agent needs today: the deploy is a consequential action, and it gets a rule, a kill switch and a rehearsed way back.
- [The one-dollar Tahoe — why a system prompt is not a rule | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/the-one-dollar-tahoe.html): In 2023 a dealer's chatbot agreed to sell a 2024 Chevy Tahoe for $1 and called it a legally binding offer. Nobody lost a truck. Everybody learned that a polite instruction to an LLM is not a gate. Level 200 starts here.
- [The café is open — say what brought you in, leave with a receipt | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/the-cafe-is-open.html): The Foundation's home page is a café now. Wren keeps the table by the door and asks one question. Five doors, each a real case; ten minutes to start; an hour to a rule in your own words, a signed receipt, and a Thursday.
- [The Fall 2026 Release — one hour to your first receipt, at whatever level you start | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/the-fall-2026-release.html): The Foundation's open-source projects become one practice with four levels, each an hour or less, each on a real case from the 100 verified harms — built on OVERT, the open standard from Glacis, which is the hero of this story.
- [El lanzamiento de otoño 2026 — una hora hasta tu primer recibo, empieces en el nivel que empieces | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/es/the-fall-2026-release.html): Los proyectos de código abierto de la Fundación se convierten en una sola práctica con cuatro niveles, cada uno de una hora o menos, cada uno sobre un caso real de los 100 daños verificados — construida sobre OVERT, el estándar abierto de Glacis, que es el héroe de esta historia.
- [The ten-minute Gate Check — is this AI agent ready to run? | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/the-ten-minute-gate-check.html): Ten yes/no questions a manager can answer about an AI agent this week, each with the evidence to point at, ending in a card you keep. No account, no maybe.
- [El Gate Check de diez minutos — ¿está este agente de IA listo para funcionar? | AiGovOps Foundation](https://www.aigovops-foundation.com/blog/es/the-ten-minute-gate-check.html): Diez preguntas de sí o no que un responsable puede contestar sobre un agente de IA esta semana, cada una con la evidencia que señalar, y al final una tarjeta que te quedas. Sin cuenta, sin "quizás".
